title: Registration: First Step

hint: Create a user account on the website — two words: 'Sign up'.

prompt: How is selling your car through Quicks described?

title: Registration: Next Step
prompt: What do you do after signing up to register as a car dealer on Quicks?

ja.sample: ビジネスアカウントにアップグレードして情報を送信します。
